rounds.text: City Crops Agro Ltd is currently demonstrating a significant operational turnaround, evidenced by a quarterly operating margin that has doubled from 6% to 12% year-over-year [E22]. This momentum is supported by recent screen signals confirming both year-over-year profit growth exceeding 20% and sequential quarterly sales growth [E52, E54]. While the long-term compounded sales growth of 41% highlights the company's historical capacity for expansion [E13], the market is currently pricing the stock at the top of its 52-week range, reflecting strong investor confidence in this recovery [E4]. The valuation remains reasonable at a price-to-book ratio of 1.74x, which is closely aligned with the sector benchmark of 1.79x [E1, E6]. Conceded: [E3, E15, E21, E43, E55]. Despite recent volatility in annual sales, the company is clearly pivoting toward improved profitability and efficiency [E22, E52].
